obligation: G005 — the vector items the first pass did not measure

sealed-3.14.why: MIX_REPORT has no payload_bytes_by_role; this body predates the per-role accounting and its active vector cannot be derived from bytes

variantA-2.98.dram_assumption: one full read of every non-embedding organ per decoded token. The body is 8.7-10.0 GB against a far smaller cache, so inter-token reuse is assumed zero. This is an UPPER bound on useful traffic and therefore a LOWER bound on the reachable roof.
variantA-2.98.roof_scope: this executable, this regime. Directive §76: never copied to another model or another representation.

clean-2.60.dram_assumption: one full read of every non-embedding organ per decoded token. The body is 8.7-10.0 GB against a far smaller cache, so inter-token reuse is assumed zero. This is an UPPER bound on useful traffic and therefore a LOWER bound on the reachable roof.

frozen_design_constant_observed.verdict: a design constant published under a physical name; canary D of G033 predicts exactly this. Every figure in physical_vectors is recomputed from payload_bytes_by_role.

concurrency.method: ALTERNATING PAIRED REPS. Two earlier single-pass sweeps disagreed at c4 by 33% and one of them reported a collapse that does not exist: a single Metal sweep is page-cache confounded. Levels are alternated within each rep so drift is shared, and the within-level spread is published as part of the result.
concurrency.equilibrium_definition: the highest level whose reps are reproducible (spread under 15% of median). Levels above it reach higher medians but are not stable enough to be a operating point.

superseded_single_sweeps.why_discarded: unpaired and single-rep; sweep_2 reported a knee at c2 that the paired reps refute (c4 is 24% ABOVE c2, not below)

collapse.mechanism: each stream is a separate PROCESS loading its own copy of the 8.7 GB body. At c12 that is roughly 105 GB of Metal working set against a recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize near 78 GiB, so the collapse is an admission failure, not a scheduling one.
collapse.consequence: S011 §29 asks for one resident body and many logical states. This measurement is the argument for it: the ceiling here is weight REPLICATION, not decode throughput.

verified_wus_per_hour.basis: a WorkUnit is only counted when its output is VERIFIED. On the canonical capability suite the clean-2.60 body scores 3/43 and variantA 0/43, and none of the passes are production tasks -- so no body in this ladder produces a verified accepted WorkUnit at any rate. The figure is zero because the bodies are capability-dead, not because the measurement is missing.
verified_wus_per_hour.canonical_definition_pending: G039 owns the HCLI bench and the scoring rule; this is the honest floor until then.

anomaly_variantA_short_generation.observed: variantA-2.98 emitted 2 tokens per run with decode_steps=1, against 24 tokens and 23 steps for the other two bodies
anomaly_variantA_short_generation.consequence: its TPOT is computed over 175 sampled steps rather than 285, and its wall-clock figures are NOT comparable to the others
anomaly_variantA_short_generation.reading: an early stop is itself a capability signal, consistent with variantA scoring 0/43

bench.machine: Apple M3 Ultra, 60 GPU cores, 96 GiB (receipts/headless/MACHINE_GENOME.json)
bench.rule: S032 §3 -- if quiescence is unknown the state is UNKNOWN, not quiet
bench.provenance: this receipt was written before quiescence was a benchmark input and recorded none. UNKNOWN is what it measured under, not a claim that the machine was busy
